02-revoke-stripped.says: authorised by signers, roots **or** the device itself (`threshold`)

03-revoke-genuine.says: genuine entry, is refused, and the genuine entry is judged on its own

05-note-genuine.says: why the two kinds of key stay apart (H1).

06-copy-applied-extra-sig.says: other signature list is `dup-entry` here, before any later rule can judge

07-copy-refused-bytes.says: it, and so is a byte copy of any entry. But a **refused** entry burns

08-log-key-anchor.says: `pk` is not an active log key — `anchor.log_key` or any `pk` in `log_keys`

10-log-key-learned.says: `pk` is not an active log key — `anchor.log_key` or any `pk` in `log_keys`

11-policy-name-not-ascii.says: A witness or group name follows §7's key-name grammar

13-params-two-byte-true.says: `0xf8` followed by any byte below 32 — `0xf8 0x14` and `0xf8 0x15`

15-copy-genesis-extra-sig.says: 1. Its `entry_hash` joins §5.1 step 1's first seen set, and when step 8 applies it, its `content_hash` joins the second (D-078).
